blocks.t: When assembling your Skins Game Universal Conversion Kit (34042),
note that the Keypad Harness (H-23445.2) has similar connectors at each end. If you inadvertently mate the keypad end into the CPU Board, and vice-versa, the keypad will not work.
The best way to distinguish between the two connectors is to note the orientation of the colored wires on each connector.
